name: Amara Okafor
bio: Amara works with prospective customers to find a useful first pilot. She keeps commercial commitments specific and makes sure a promising deal is also a good fit.
responsibilities: Customer fit, discovery calls, pilot scope, and sales proposals.
Approval of subscription discounts above 10% and up to 20%.
Sales escalations and commercial expectations. Discounts above 20% go to Finance and the managing director; custom payment terms go to Finance.
